notice: This is a demo. Nothing was written. This is what saving the plan would write.
copyToStick: Plug in the ceremony USB stick before you save the plan: ritueel refreshes the stick's extra partition itself with the program and the bundle ~/ritueel/personal, with history/20261111T090000Z-personal-subkey-revoke/plan.json inside it. Proposed (record 0005, issue 30): with no stick present the plan is still made and you are told the stick is not current.
bring: The PIN of root card one: you type it at the terminal there, never here
The key file of your primary: it is in the stick's extra partition, beside the bundle, never inside it
The ceremony stick: it boots vanilla AirgapOS and carries everything above (there is no second stick)
whenBack: Bring the stick back, copy the bundle from its extra partition over ~/ritueel/personal and reload this page. The new record appears in History.
